flows.title: Create a design file
steps: Select Design from the menu. The new file opens in the Figma Design editor. Typing figma.new in the address bar also creates a new design file.

flows.title: Share a file
steps: Open the file and click Share in the top-right corner.

To invite people, enter their email addresses or user group names in the invite field, separated by commas, adjust each person's permissions, and click Send invite. Invitees get an email and a notification in the file browser.
To share by link instead, adjust the share settings and permissions in the share modal, then click Copy link and send the link to collaborators.

flows.title: Add a comment to a file
steps: Click the comment icon in the toolbar, or press C, to enter comment mode.
Click the place on the canvas to pin the comment, or click and drag to select a region.
Type the message. Press @ to mention a collaborator.
Click the send button to post the comment.
